topics.topic_name: Threat model & access control for encrypted data
topics.justification: Top terms like "access", "protect", "attack/attacker", "trust", and "server/user/phone" indicate discussions about who can access encrypted data, what an attacker can do, and how security assumptions change across devices and servers.

topics.topic_name: Key storage in device memory (software vs hardware)
topics.justification: Dominant words "key", "store", "memory", "read", and "process" point to protecting secrets while in RAM and against extraction, with "hardware/chip" and "private_key" suggesting secure elements/TPM/HSM versus purely software key handling.

topics.topic_name: File/disk encryption with passwords (containers, boot, backups)
topics.justification: The mix of "file", "encrypt/encryption", "password", "disk/drive", and "container/boot/backup" aligns with full-disk or file-container encryption workflows, including password-based unlocking, boot-time considerations, and copying/backups.
